sql: SELECT 'A_realized_today' AS what, COALESCE(strategy,'-') AS k, to_char(COALESCE(SUM(pnl),0),'FM990.0000') AS v FROM paper_trades WHERE strategy IN ('Emmsell10','Emmsell10_pt4') AND closed_at >= date_trunc('day', (now() at time zone 'utc')) GROUP BY 1,2 UNION ALL SELECT 'B_orders_since_rearm', COALESCE(status,'-'), count(*)::text FROM live_orders WHERE strategy = 'Emmsell10' AND created_at > timestamptz '2026-09-06 23:51:41+00' GROUP BY 1,2 UNION ALL SELECT 'C_open_pos', strategy, count(*)::text FROM paper_trades WHERE strategy IN ('Emmsell10','Emmsell10_pt4','mmsell10','Gmmsell1') AND closed_at IS NULL GROUP BY 1,2 UNION ALL SELECT 'D_funnel', to_char(created_at,'HH24:MI'), 'E='||COALESCE((raw_json->'per_book'->>'Emmsell10'),'0') ||' m10='||COALESCE((raw_json->'per_book'->>'mmsell10'),'0') ||' G1='||COALESCE((raw_json->'per_book'->>'Gmmsell1'),'0') ||' opened='||COALESCE(raw_json->>'opened','?') ||' ccap='||COALESCE(raw_json->>'skipped_contest_cap','?') ||' tier='||COALESCE(raw_json->>'skipped_live_tier','?') ||' paused='||COALESCE(raw_json->>'skipped_live_paused','?') ||' inband='||COALESCE(raw_json->>'in_band','?') FROM system_events WHERE component='mmsell_scan' AND created_at > now() - interval '70 minutes' ORDER BY 1,2
